arguments.body: Hi Ashford, thanks for your update. We have recorded your £95 including VAT quote for the replacement dial and sent it to the landlord for a decision. The landlord's approval so far covered the inspection only, so please do not order parts or carry out further work until we confirm approval. We will update you by 10 December. Please also send your invoice for the visit and any photos of the work done, and confirm the company name you are working under.

Dear Amelia, the contractor attended and tightened a loose connection, and reports the dishwasher ran normally on test. He also found a dial missing, which needs ordering. We have asked the landlord to approve that cost and are waiting for their answer. Please let us know if the dishwasher still fails to finish its cycle. We will update you by 10 December.
